import_scan.method: nm -D --undefined-only and objdump -T on the exact analysed artifacts; provider filter ^OSSL_PROVIDER|_provider_|do_all
import_scan.answer: Neither consumer imports OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all or any OSSL_PROVIDER_* symbol. Both do import EVP entry points whose implementation reaches ossl_provider_doall_activated, but through the fixed in-image callback described below, not through an application callback.

callee.cb_provenance: rbp is loaded at 0x46b9a0 from 0x18(%rsp), stored at 0x46b7d9 from r15, and r15 received the incoming rsi at 0x46b761 (mov %rsi,%r15); the argument is the third ABI argument cb, forwarded by the caller

callers.callback_argument: incoming rsi, forwarded unchanged (prologue pushes r14/rbx and subtracts rsp only; rdi/rsi/rdx are untouched before the call)

in_image_callers.other_callers: none: objdump -d over the whole image reports exactly these two direct call sites of 0x46b750
in_image_callers.address_taken_check: readelf -rW shows no relocation naming 0x441860 and objdump finds no lea/mov/call to 0x441860 outside the function's own label; OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all is not address-taken in-image

reachability.method: direct-call BFS over objdump -d direct call edges in libcrypto.so.3, rooted at the addresses the consumer imports (178 roots for ssh, 131 for sshd). A direct-call path is a genuine reachable path and does not depend on any indirect resolution.
reachability.engine_cross_check: edge-targets.json records reachable_in_openssh_closure=true for the 0x46b9c5 site; the direct BFS independently reproduces reachability without the resolver

shortest_chain_both: EVP_DigestVerifyInit (libcrypto export, imported by ssh and sshd)
doall_activated_reachable.note: other imported EVP entry points reach the same function through other in-image paths; the named chain is the shortest one BFS finds and is sufficient

OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all_reachable.why: not imported by either consumer, no in-image call/lea/mov reference, no relocation naming 0x441860, and it is not in the BFS reachable set

verdict.label: UNREACHABLE_FOR_CONSUMER
verdict.decisive_fact: The containing function is reachable in both consumers, but only through ossl_algorithm_do_all's call at 0x51deeb, which passes the link-time-constant local callback algorithm_do_this (0x51dc20). The only application-supplied caller, exported OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all (call at 0x441867), is not imported by ssh or sshd, has no in-image reference or relocation, and is not in the reachable set. Therefore the unresolved application-callback target set attributed to OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all lies outside both consumers' closures.
verdict.qualification: Verdict A is claimed for the disputed application-supplied edge, not for the function's reachability in general: ossl_provider_doall_activated is itself reachable on a fixed in-image callback. The engine's unresolved classification is an over-approximation from an unreachable caller, not a reachable application edge.
verdict.consequence: Element 7 can be established for ssh/sshd on reachability grounds for this edge without widening any contract class. This receipt does not perform that adjudication and does not change the closure's recorded FAIL or its STALE_HASH refusal.
